meta.name: antinet-four-color-cards
meta.description: 财务和投资分析师、律师助理与法律助手在撰写金融研报或分析法律文档时，必用此技能！基于解析文档一键生成事实蓝卡、解释绿卡、风险黄卡与行动红卡。自动完成深度剖析与风险排查，产出100%可溯源的结构化四色报告，让复杂分析高效且严谨。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 解析文档,生成四色分析卡,让复杂金融与法律分析高效严谨
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你需要快速梳理金融研报或法律文档中的事实与风险
copy.tagline_en: Turn complex documents into structured four-color analysis reports for finance and law.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to break down financial reports or legal documents into key facts and risks.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会把结构化文档拆成四张卡片:蓝卡(事实)、绿卡(解释)、黄卡(风险)、红卡(行动),每张附来源片段;无来源时不生成断言。
howto.when: 在你提供解析好的结构化文档(markdown)并说明分析目标时接管,用于金融研报、法律文档等分析;LLM 不可用则降级为规则引擎生成。

say.text: 把这份 markdown 生成四色卡片,先出蓝卡事实
say.note: 走 extract 阶段,产出带来源的事实卡

say.text: 用四色卡片排查这份研报的过度声明和风险
say.note: 黄卡经监察院复核,超时标 pending_review

say.text: 基于这些卡片给出下一步行动建议
say.note: 走 propose 阶段,红卡由丞相府补全

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude turns a structured document into four cards: blue (facts), green (explanations), yellow (risks) and red (actions), each with source snippets; no assertion is made without a source.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you supply a parsed structured document (markdown) with an analysis goal, e.g. financial or legal document analysis. If the LLM is unavailable it falls back to a rule engine.

say_en.text: Turn this markdown into four color cards, start with the blue fact card
say_en.note: Runs the extract stage, producing sourced fact cards

say_en.text: Use four color cards to check this report for overclaims and risks
say_en.note: Yellow card is audited; timeout marks pending_review

say_en.text: Suggest next actions based on these cards
say_en.note: Runs the propose stage for the red action card
